messages:
alex: Heads up — onboarding demo (Vercel Edge) crashed with a weird prototype error when importing the JS SDK. Posting details.
mira: paste the stack and your import line plz
jamal: quick guess: CJS leaking into an ESM runtime. many bundlers still prefer main or get confused by exports mapping.
alex: error: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')` when calling `new Client()` in the edge function. Import is `import { Client } from 'redwood-sdk'`.
mira: show exports block?
alex: snippet: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  }
}
"main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs", "module": "dist/esm/index.mjs"
```

jamal: ok typical. two failure modes: 1) resolver picked CJS (main) for edge, 2) esm artifact still contains `require()` calls (transitive node-only dep).
mira: we shipped an auth shim that does `const fetch = globalThis.fetch || require('node-fetch')` in source. Babel/esbuild transform left the `require('node-fetch')` in the ESM output in some builds. That causes runtime crash in Workers.
alex: ugh. Tests in CI use Node, so they miss this.
jamal: plan: (A) factor auth/retry into a runtime-agnostic module with explicit adapters imported per entrypoint, (B) add a CI lint that greps `dist/esm` for `require(` and `module.exports`, (C) add an explicit `"./types": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }` export so TS/IDE resolution is deterministic, (D) add `browser` field under exports to bias bundlers to ESM for browser/edge.
mira: +1. also add `tsc --traceResolution` check in CI against a minimal consumer to ensure editors pick correct d.ts.
alex: temporary mitigation: point `main` at the esm build in a patch release to reduce edge fallout. Caveat: breaks old `require()` consumers. We'll communicate in changelog if we do.
jamal: and add a tiny Cloudflare/Vercel worker repro to sample-apps and run it under our emulation in CI as a regression test. I'll prototype the `require()`-scan script and add the failing job.
build-bot: ci/pipeline  added job "esm-no-cjs" and "tsc-trace-resolve" to PR matrix on branch alex/edge-repro.
ci-bot: ci/checks  lint + repro tests queued.
mira: one more subtlety: some bundlers prefer `browser` then `module` then `main`. Ensure package.json sets `browser` + `module` to the esm entry and keep cjs only under exports.require.
alex: thanks y'all. I'll open the refactor PR with the repro and docs note for onboarding (how to force ESM import if your bundler prefers main). :thumbsup:
